The climate in Geneva

Geneva is about 370 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 27°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 0°C. Around 1210 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in May (about 134 mm). The highest temperature in Geneva in 2015–2024 was 38°C (24 August 2023) and the lowest −8°C (27 February 2018).

Best time to visit Geneva

The most pleasant weather in Geneva is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 21°C and 27°C, with up to 13 days of rain a month.
